如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    刀疤脸这伙捣乱的人走了，杨云帆便不去管一旁的许强，又开始坐下来吃饭。
等杨云帆吃饱喝足，背着旅行包开始往星海国际给他安排的房子而去。
这一下，一直等在一旁的许强就急了：“神医，你看，什么时候跟我去见一下我们林姐？要不，现在天色还早，就今天吧？”
“今天可不行。”
杨云帆摇了摇头，道：“我今天刚到湘潭市，已经累了一天了。而且，我明天一大早要去见一个人。虽然我不怎么想去，不过，这是我师傅安排的。我再不愿意去，也得去见一面。那叫礼貌。唉……真是够麻烦的。”
说着，杨云帆也不管许强，自顾走了。
“神医，明天早上，你要去见人，我没意见。那明天晚上，我再来这里等你，可以吗？”许强却不肯离开，非得杨云帆同意了才行。
杨云帆想了想道：“明天晚上我确实没什么事情。好吧，那就明天晚上吧。如果我真的没有什么事情的话。”
“好，那就说定了！”许强高兴道。
等杨云帆走远之后，许强对自己四个手下吩咐道：“你们几个，轮流给我跟着他。。这个人，不像我们看起来那么简单。”
“知道了，强哥。”那四个手下都是退伍兵，原先是侦察连的。论盯梢，那是一绝。他们可不信，在自己眼皮底子下，还能让人溜了。
“18幢，三单元，502，应该就是这里吧。”
杨云帆看着那张写着地址的纸条，又看了钥匙上写着的502.
他对准钥匙孔，插进钥匙，一扭动。
“卡啦”一下，门房间不大，但是麻雀虽小五脏俱全。电视机，电饭锅，什么都有。而且，好像刚刚有人来打扫过，倒是不脏。
杨云帆把自己的行礼放好，又收拾了一下房间，总觉得有件事好像没有做。
“对了！明天，要跟我的未婚妻叶轻雪见面了。第一次见面，可不能空着手去，太丢人了。”
杨云帆决定，要给对方带一点见面礼。
“不过，送点什么礼物呢？”
杨云帆又犯了愁。对方是个大小姐，又是个大总裁，好像很有钱，估计什么都不缺。

“既然她不缺世俗上的东西，那就送点她没有的东西！”
忽然间，杨云帆想到了一个绝好的礼物。
夺天地之造化，凝五气之元华。
它是居家旅行，杀人保命的最佳道具。当然，一般人是无法炼制符箓的。在现代社会，符箓就跟天书一样，让人看不懂。也只有杨云帆这样，得了上古传承，修炼了最正宗玄门功法的人，才会对符箓有所了解。
杨云帆就想送叶轻雪一枚护身符。毕竟是自己的未婚妻，出手不能太小气。太丢人！
至于炼制符箓最好的材料，当然是玉器。
不过，如今，杨云帆的修为恰恰进入引气境第一层，想要在一块玉上一气呵成的撰写符箓，那是绝对做不到的。所以，他只能退而求其次，选择先用黄纸代替玉，制作一些一次性的纸符。
纸符只能使用一次，效果也远远不如玉符，但是，胜在容易炼制。
最重要的是，材料便宜。
城西老街，二十年以前是湘潭的市中心。只是，随着城市的不断扩建，商业街，市中心都慢慢的往东边搬迁。而这城西老街便逐渐成为了湘潭市的郊区。不过就因为这个原因，有很多当地民俗在这里被保留了下来。
黄纸，香烛，朱砂之类的宗教物品，其他地方难买，可是在这里，却能找出好几家。而且规模还都不小。
而在老街的深处，则是湘潭市赫赫有名的古玩街。
每天来到古玩街淘宝人，络绎不绝。有些人是怀揣着发财大梦而来的，妄图能够在大多数的赝品中，一眼找出被埋没了的真品。往往这样的人，都赔的很惨。
当然，古玩街里还存有某些老字号的店面，这些店面虽然不大，但是古色古香，里面确实有一些货真价实的东西。但是，你要没有圈内人的引荐，恐怕连这些好东西的影子都看不到。
古玩古玩，那就是古人拿在手里赏玩的东西，其中玉器可占了不少。若是能以低价购得一两块珍品宝玉，炼制出的玉符，效果一定非常不错。
可惜啊，杨云帆摸了摸口袋，自己身上的钱可没多少。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Scarface and the troublemakers left, Yang Yunfan ignored Xu Qiang and began to sit down to eat again.
After Yang Yunfan had eaten and drank enough, he started to go to the house arranged for him by Xinghai International with his travel bag on his back.
At this time, Xu Qiang, who had been waiting aside, became anxious: "Look, miracle doctor, when are you going to come with me to see our Sister Lin? Otherwise, it's still early, so today?"
"Not today."
Yang Yunfan shook his head and said: "I just arrived in Xiangtan City today and have been tired for a day. Moreover, I have to meet someone early tomorrow morning. Although I don't really want to go, it is arranged by my master. Even if I don't want to go, I have to go and meet him. That's called politeness. Alas... it's really troublesome."
With that said, Yang Yunfan ignored Xu Qiang and left.
"Miracle doctor, I have no problem with you going to see someone tomorrow morning. Then tomorrow night, I'll wait for you here again, okay?" Xu Qiang refused to leave, and Yang Yunfan had to agree.
Yang Yunfan thought for a while and said: "I really have nothing to do tomorrow night. Okay, then let's do it tomorrow night. If I really have nothing to do."
"Okay, it's settled!" Xu Qiang said happily.
After Yang Yunfan walked away, Xu Qiang ordered his four subordinates: "You guys, take turns following him... This person is not as simple as we seem."
"I got it, Brother Qiang." Those four men were all veterans and were originally from the reconnaissance company. When it comes to stalking, that's one of the best. They didn't believe that someone could escape right under their noses.
"Building 18, unit three, 502, this should be it."
Yang Yunfan looked at the piece of paper with the address and then the 502 written on the key.
He aimed at the keyhole, inserted the key, and twisted it.
"Click", the door room is not big, but although the sparrow is small, it has all the internal organs. TV, rice cooker, everything. Moreover, it seemed that someone had just cleaned it, so it was not dirty.
Yang Yunfan put away his gifts and tidied the room, but he felt that something had not been done.
"By the way! Tomorrow, I'm going to meet my fiancée Ye Qingxue. It's our first meeting, so we can't go empty-handed, it's too embarrassing."
Yang Yunfan decided to bring a little greeting gift to the other party.
"But what kind of gift should I give you?"
Yang Yunfan was worried again. The other party is a young lady and a big CEO. She seems to be very rich and probably needs everything.
"Since she doesn't lack worldly things, give her something she doesn't have!"
Suddenly, Yang Yunfan thought of an excellent gift.
Capture the creation of heaven and earth, and condense the essence of the five qi.
It is the best prop for home travel and killing people to save lives. Of course, ordinary people cannot refine talismans. In modern society, talismans are as incomprehensible as heavenly books. Only people like Yang Yunfan, who have received ancient inheritance and practiced the most authentic Xuanmen techniques, can understand the talismans.
Yang Yunfan wanted to give Ye Qingxue an amulet. After all, she is his fiancée, so she can't be too stingy. What a shame!
As for the best material for refining talismans, of course it is jade.
However, now, Yang Yunfan's cultivation has just entered the first level of the Qi-Entraining Realm. It is absolutely impossible to write a talisman on a piece of jade in one go. Therefore, he could only settle for the next best thing and choose to use yellow paper instead of jade to make some one-time paper charms.
The paper talisman can only be used once, and its effect is far inferior to that of the jade talisman. However, it is easier to refine than the paper talisman.
Best of all, the materials are cheap.
The old street in the west of the city was the city center of Xiangtan twenty years ago. However, as the city continues to expand, commercial streets and the city center are slowly moving eastward. And this old street in the west of the city gradually became the suburbs of Xiangtan City. But just for this reason, many local folk customs have been preserved here.
Religious items such as yellow paper, incense candles, and cinnabar are difficult to buy elsewhere, but here, you can find several. And the scale is not small.
Deep in the old street is the famous Antique Street in Xiangtan City.
There is an endless stream of people who come to Antique Street to hunt for treasures every day. Some people come with big dreams of getting rich, hoping to find the authentic ones buried among the majority of fakes at a glance. Often such people suffer miserably.
Of course, there are still some time-honored stores in the Antique Street. Although these stores are not big, they are antique and do have some genuine things inside. However, if you don’t have referrals from people in the industry, you may not even be able to see the shadow of these good things.
Antiques and antiques are things that the ancients held in their hands for appreciation, and jade articles accounted for a lot of them. If you can buy one or two pieces of precious jade at a low price, the jade talisman you can refine will be very effective.
It's a pity. Yang Yunfan touched his pocket and found that he didn't have much money on him.
